The '''Rift Alliance Coalition Forces''' was the combined military forces of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] members of the [[Rift Alliance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They answered first to the Rift Alliance's leaders and performed many [[Rift Alliance campaign|missions]] for them. One unit was a contingent based on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] commanded by [[Felix Iresso]]. When the Rift Alliance rejoined the Republic, the Coalition Forces were reabsorbed into the Republic Army but were still unofficially under the command of the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].
